seo.title: How it works — Seniors Property Advisors
seo.description: Four calm steps from first conversation to sold, with an independent advisor walking with you the whole way.

data.heading: A simple, supported process —
data.lead: Four calm steps, with an advisor walking with you the whole way.

items.title: Tell us about your property
items.body: A short conversation about your home, your timeline and what matters most to you in this move.

items.title: We research suitable agents
items.body: We review recent sales, listing prices and seller reviews to shortlist agents who genuinely fit your suburb.

items.title: You compare your options
items.body: Receive a clear comparison — experience, recent sales, fees and marketing — with notes from your advisor.

items.title: Choose the agent that fits
items.body: Meet your shortlist on your terms, with our advisor present if you’d like. Decide in your own time.
